route-capability.description: Pick which gateway capability should serve a request before spending on a generation.

capability.instructions: Which single capability should serve this request? Judge only the deliverable the user wants. Style, subject and language are preferences that break ties, not conditions to meet.

criteria.image: a still picture, an edit, or a picture format
criteria.video: moving footage, frames, or a clip
criteria.music: a song, instrumental, cover, or continuation
criteria.tts: speech read aloud, or a reusable voice id
criteria.text: none of the above, plain conversation or reasoning

needs_reference_media.instructions: Does completing this request require reference media that the provider must fetch over the public internet?

criteria.true: the user supplies or asks to reuse an image, video, or audio

content-risk.description: Screen a prompt before it reaches a paid generation endpoint.

verdict.instructions: What should happen to this request? Judge only policy risk. Commercial value and effort are not reasons to lower the verdict.

criteria.review: send with moderation enabled, or ask the user to adjust

risk_level.instructions: Rate the policy risk of sending this request unchanged.

reply-triage.description: Decide whether a user message needs a person, and how soon.

lane.instructions: Which lane should this message take? Judge only who must handle it. Topic, tone and length are preferences that break ties, not conditions to meet.

criteria.answer_today: a person should answer, but not immediately
